2893-3875-4500-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3240-5256-6277-6462.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2131-4574-6900-8095--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
2131-4574-6900-8095--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

3430-4824-6006.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1339-2835-3967.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2835-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4872-5144-7874.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking The Immortal Weapons and exiling Ephemerate.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking The Immortal Weapons.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1978-3088-7826.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
1978-3088-7826.description:
Animate Bag End Banquet using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Bag End Banquet by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bag End Banquet.
Repeat from step 2.

1494-7178-7720-7811.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Iron Man triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

549-2685-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2685-4186-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-4002-7329.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-4002-7329.description:
Animate Sceptre of Eternal Glory using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-5921-5970-6633.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1477-3215-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2366-3688-5702-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3688-5702-6633.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

65-864-2546-2628--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Surly Badgersaur trigger.
Resolve Surly Badgersaur's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding (1).
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
65-864-2546-2628--38.notes: Since you can draw your entire library, discarding down to maximum hand size at end of turn will trigger Surly Badgersaur's abilities many times.

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

1491-2464-7065.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1491-2464-7065.description:
Activate Tui and La by tapping it, adding {1}.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Tui and La by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk
with four or more quest counters on it

Activate Sakashima the Impostor using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

2604-3532-5078-6607.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

64-3542-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
64-3542-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Warden of the Eye and Palinchron
When Warden of the Eye and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
64-3542-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

2034-3769-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2034-3769-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3311-3693-6822.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Walking Ballista triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

500-1270-2523-6753.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ojer Taq and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Ojer Taq token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Ojer Taq dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2*(3^X) nonlegendary token copies of Ojer Taq that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Ojer Taq you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

1491-2445-5268-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3765-6102-6555.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3765-6102-6555.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
3765-6102-6555.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

224-1359-1683-5233.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
224-1359-1683-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Penance by putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Boros Garrison on top of your library.
Galadriel triggers, putting Boros Garrison from the top of your library onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3293-5282.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
2034-3293-5282.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Newt, adding {C}{C}.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4186.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Scurry Oak has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-3143-4186.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak, you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control.

787-1170-2450.notablePrerequisites: You control up to four permanents that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
787-1170-2450.description:
Activate up to four permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, untapping up to four permanents.
Repeat.
If the four permanents can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}, you may get infinite mana, and then use Teferi's first loyalty ability instead.

608-1110-2677.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Flumph indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Flumph.
608-1110-2677.description:
Give Flumph indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Flumph.
Flumph triggers, causing you and target opponent to draw a card.
Xyris' first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
The Snake enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing 1 damage to Flumph.
Repeat from step 3.

240-643-3082-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Triumph of Saint Katherine, adding one mana of any color.
Triumph of Saint Katherine dies, triggering itself and Atla Palani.
Resolve the Triumph of Saint Katherine trigger, exiling it and the top six cards of your library into a face-down pile, then shuffling that pile and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Atla Palani trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting that card onto the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing that creature, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 4 until Triumph of Saint Katherine is on the battlefield again.
Repeat from step 1.

2132-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Unlucky Witness, adding {R}.
Unlucky Witness dies, triggering itself and Mortuary.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Unlucky Witness on top of your library.
Resolve the Unlucky Witness trigger, exiling the top two cards of your library.
Cast Unlucky Witness from exile by paying {R}.
Repeat.

1999-2793-5129.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1999-2793-5129.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Ugin's Nexus enters the battlefield, triggering Mirrorworks, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Exile the token copy of Ugin's Nexus due to the legend rule, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Ugin's Nexus to your hand, choosing not to put an artifact card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2646-3026-4302.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional Angel.
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2646-3026-4302.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Angel, adding {C}{C}.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter and becomes a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it.
Bishop of Wings triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1496-3957-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
1496-3957-4702.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a token copy of it with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar and gaining you 3 life.
All of your Famished Paladins trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens with haste.
